title: Advances in systems biology modeling: 10 years of crowdsourcing DREAM challenges.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述了DREAM挑战赛在系统生物学建模中的进展，涵盖转录因子结合等蛋白质-DNA互作相关任务，但以宽泛综述为主，缺乏具体AI/物理模拟方法创新，与TF-DNA互作机制建模关联有限。
abstract: Computational and mathematical models are key to obtain a system-level understanding of biological processes, but their limitations have to be clearly defined to allow their proper application and interpretation. Crowdsourced benchmarks in the form of challenges provide an unbiased assessment of methods, and for the past decade, the Dialogue for Reverse Engineering Assessment and Methods (DREAM) organized more than 15 systems biology challenges. From transcription factor binding to dynamical network models, from signaling networks to gene regulation, from whole-cell models to cell-lineage reconstruction, and from single-cell positioning in a tissue to drug combinations and cell survival, the breadth is broad. To celebrate the 5-year anniversary of Cell Systems, we review the genesis of these systems biology challenges and discuss how interlocking the forward- and reverse-modeling paradigms allows to push the rim of systems biology. This approach will persist for systems levels approaches in biology and medicine.
abstract_zh: 计算和数学模型是获得生物过程系统级理解的关键，但其局限性必须明确界定，以确保其正确应用和解释。以挑战赛形式进行的众包基准测试提供了对方法的无偏评估，在过去十年中，逆向工程评估与方法对话（DREAM）组织了超过15项系统生物学挑战。从转录因子结合到动态网络模型，从信号网络到基因调控，从全细胞模型到细胞谱系重建，从组织中单细胞定位到药物组合与细胞存活，其范围广泛。为庆祝《细胞系统》创刊五周年，我们回顾了这些系统生物学挑战的起源，并探讨了正向与逆向建模范式的相互交织如何推动系统生物学的边界。这一方法将持续应用于生物学和医学中的系统级研究。
